meta.description: Verified 2024 inputs for the import-share (absorption) calibration of the nested model. All trade flows are goods only, billions of USD, importer-reported where available.
principles: Importer-reported flows preferred (US: Census; EU: Eurostat; China: GACC; Vietnam: VN customs).
Expenditure share of country i on partner j's goods = imports_ij / GDP_i (share of total expenditure).

Home tradable share: alpha_D_i = (alpha_T - sum_j shares_ij) / alpha_T within each three-country configuration; goods from outside the trio are treated as part of home tradables (conservative for the diversion mechanism).

Vietnam caveat: gross imports include heavy processing/re-export content, overstating final absorption; a sensitivity variant treats 50% of VN imports from China as final absorption. Flagged, not resolved.

sources.us_trade: US Census Bureau, 2024 year-to-date (Dec) goods trade by partner, Census basis
sources.us_eu: US Census via BEA annual 2024: exports 370.2, imports 605.8
sources.eu_trade: Eurostat news 2025-03-04 / 2025-03-11: EU-China imports EUR 517.8bn, exports EUR 213.3bn; EU imports from US EUR 333.4bn, exports EUR 531.6bn (2024)
sources.china_trade: GACC 2024: US-China total $688.28bn, China exports to US $524.66bn; imports from EU CNY 1,916.4bn; totals: exports CNY 25.45tn, imports CNY 18.39tn
sources.vietnam_trade: VN customs 2024: imports from China $144.0bn; exports to China $61.2bn; total imports $380.76bn, total exports $405.53bn
sources.gdp: IMF WEO 2024 nominal, current USD: US 29,184.9; China 18,273.4; Japan 4,070.1; India 3,889.1. Others widely-reported 2024 values, re-verify against WEO vintage: EU ~19,410 (Eurostat EUR 17.94tn at 1.0824); Korea ~1,869; Taiwan ~796; Vietnam 476.3; Mexico 1,852.7; Canada 2,241.3
sources.world_gdp: IMF WEO 2024 world nominal GDP ~$110.5tn (re-verify vintage); ROW = world - US - China

gdp_ppp_2024_L.note: PPP-based size weights L_i (US=1), unchanged from the original calibration (IMF WEO PPP GDP)

goods_imports_2024.note: imports_2024[i][j] = country i's goods imports from j (importer-reported unless flagged)

flags.USA: GACC: bilateral total 688.28 minus China exports 524.66
flags.VNM: VN-reported exports to China (fob); GACC reports substantially higher (~97) incl. routing - sensitivity irrelevant at <0.5% expenditure share

flags.processing: VN gross imports are ~80% of GDP; heavy processing content - see meta.principles

flags.USA: US exports to world minus China (US-reported)
flags.CHN: China exports total ($3,574.4bn = CNY 25.45tn at 7.12) minus exports to US 524.66 (China-reported)

elasticities.note: eta = macro (home-import) Armington; rho = cross-origin. Sources: FLOR 2018 (micro > macro for a substantial fraction of goods); Li-Qiu-Wang-Zeng-Zi (CEPR DP17409, 2022): home-foreign elasticity 43% BELOW cross-foreign => rho/eta ~ 1.75; Broda-Weinstein 2006 medians ~2.5-4 at 3-digit aggregation; Fajgelbaum et al. 2020, 2024.
